decisions.sourceIdentity: Dominion project 0139 M,N: Okatie 230-115kV Substation, Jasper–Yemassee 230kV #1 Fold-in

publicSources.title: USACE Joint Public Notice SAC-2021-00203
publicSources.locator: Page 1 location paragraph; page 2 Applicant's Stated Purpose and Project Description
publicSources.evidence: The notice gives 32.3350, -81.0322 near Red Dam Road in Hardeeville, Jasper County. It describes expanding the existing Okatie 115kV station to 230/115kV and folding in Jasper–Yemassee 230kV, matching the supplied project scope.

decisions.matchReason: Named station, voltage conversion, named transmission line, utility and county context agree. Proposed source-point remains unverified and represents the permit area rather than a surveyed center.
limitations: Primary-source text was available through the public search index. Direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403; no access restriction was bypassed.
The 2022 permit notice does not update the historical project's status, date or construction window.
decisions.enables: Preview a one-project location revision through createLocationRevision using the associated proposal draft. Preserve all existing project fields and keep confidence unverified.

publicSources.evidence: Describes a 6.8-mile 115/46kV project in McCormick County near U.S. Highway 221, with a different corridor name from the supplied 6.5-mile Stevens Creek–Hooks/LR Plumb Branch project.

decisions.sourceIdentity: 17075: SAV: LITTLE OGEECHEE 230- 115KV: RELAY MODERNIZATION (sponsor: SAV)

publicSources.evidence: The utility identifies Little Ogeechee as an existing station near the new Big Ogeechee facility in the Savannah-area context, but provides no coordinate for the relay project.

decisions.matchReason: The named existing station and Savannah context are compatible with sponsor SAV and planning zone 219. The article covers a different construction project and does not establish TEAMS 17075 location.
limitations: An exact-feature lead, OpenStreetMap way 121701191, was identified through a secondary lookup. Primary feature tags and geometry were not retrieved; no coordinate from that lookup is accepted.
The public feature query returned HTTP 406 and the feature page could not be read. No bulk geocoding or image inspection was performed.
Big Ogeechee and Little Ogeechee are distinct facilities; the new-station article does not update the relay project status.
decisions.enables: Retrieve a readable primary feature or utility/permit record that identifies Little Ogeechee, its operator and 230/115kV station location, then reconcile it with TEAMS 17075. Feature lead: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/121701191. Keep location null until supported.
